# oxide_floating_ips (Data Source)

Retrieve a list of floating IPs in a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oxide_floating_ips" "example" {
  project = "my-project"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Name or ID of the project containing the floating IPs.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `floating_ips` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--floating_ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `floating_ips`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Human-readable free-form text about the floating IP.
- `id` (String) Unique, immutable, system-controlled identifier for the floating IP.
- `instance_id` (String) Instance ID that this floating IP is attached to, if presently attached.
- `ip` (String) IP address for this floating IP.
- `ip_pool_id` (String) ID of the IP pool containing this floating IP.
- `name` (String) Unique, mutable, user-controlled identifier for the floating IP.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where this floating IP is located.
- `time_created` (String) Timestamp when this floating IP was created.
- `time_modified` (String) Timestamp when this floating IP was last modified.
